site_visit.headline: See the operation for yourself
site_visit.description: Strategic and Anchor tier investors are welcome to visit our primary Busia, Uganda facility. Site visits include a full process walkthrough - extraction, gravity concentration, smelting, and assay - plus a meeting with our operations leadership team.

process_steps.title: Submit a request
process_steps.description: Use the contact form above selecting 'Schedule a site visit'. Include your preferred travel window (minimum 2 weeks' notice required).

process_steps.title: Pre-visit briefing
process_steps.description: Our operations team will send a site safety briefing document and itinerary 5 business days before your visit.

process_steps.title: Arrive in Busia
process_steps.description: Busia is a 4–5 hour drive from Entebbe International Airport (EBB), or a 30-minute flight to Tororo Airstrip. Airport transfer can be arranged.

process_steps.title: Full site tour
process_steps.description: Half-day guided tour of the extraction pits, processing plant, smelting furnace, and assay station. Full Q&A with site team included.

process_steps.title: Investor debrief
process_steps.description: Post-tour meeting with the CEO and CFO covering financials, documentation, and next steps for formalising your investment.

site_visit.note: Site visits are available Monday–Friday only. Minimum investment tier for site access: Strategic Partner ($75,000).

items.question: How quickly will you respond to my enquiry?
items.answer: All enquiries submitted through the contact form receive a response from the relevant team member within one business day (Monday–Friday, 08:00–17:00 EAT). Investment enquiries are prioritised and typically responded to within 4 hours during business hours.

items.question: What is in the due diligence pack?
items.answer: The AfriGold Hub due diligence pack includes: the last 6 months of audited monthly P&L statements, gold sale receipts and KRA/URA receipts, KEBS/UNBS assay certificates for the last three consignments, current Mining Licence copies, current NEMA/EIA certificate copies, the standard Partnership Investment Agreement, and a site overview presentation. Submitted on request to verified enquiries only.

items.question: Can I visit the site before committing to an investment?
items.answer: Yes. Site visits are available to Strategic and Anchor tier prospects with a minimum 2 weeks' notice. We cover the cost of in-country logistics from Entebbe to Busia for serious investor prospects. International travel is at the visitor's expense.

items.question: Are you open to investment from outside Africa?
items.answer: Yes. We have active investment partners from the UAE, Europe, and Asia. International SWIFT transfers (USD) are supported. All partnerships are governed by Ugandan law under a formal investment agreement, with an optional international arbitration clause available on request.

items.question: I represent a fund / family office. Is there a minimum ticket size above $189K?
items.answer: Yes. We accommodate larger institutional placements above the published Anchor tier on a bespoke basis. Please contact our CEO directly at invest@afrigoldhub.com for a confidential discussion.
